Definition
[Orthogonal complement] ↗ def:orthogonal-orthonormal-basis 1. appD:D.2-def-5\group Functional Analysis

For a subspace $S\subset H$, \[ S^\perp :=\{ u\in H\mid (u,v)=0\text{ for every }v\in S\} . \]
